The last Marines to leave Vietnam, aboard the last helicopter to leave the roof of the U.S. Embassy during the Fall of Saigon. 7:58 am, April 30, 1975

This picture belongs to former head of security at the Embassy Marines Master Gunnery Sgt. Juan Valdez, rear center, who was literally the final person on board the helicopter.

With the North Vietnamese Army closing in on the Embassy and all of the previous evacuations having been carried out, these Marines barricaded themselves upon the roof, without any communications equipment, hoping for a helicopter to arrive to rescue them. After waiting over 2 hours, when one finally arrived, Valdez ushered the others on board. As the helicopter was taking off and the door was closing he slipped but managed to grab onto the top of the door. Inside, Staff Sgt. Mike Sullivan conducted a head count and, after realizing someone was missing, looked back and saw Valdez' hands over the top of the door so the Marines pulled him in.
